rules: Existing XML root names cannot change in the 2.0.x line.
Additive optional schema evolution is preferred.
Removing or renaming serialized members requires explicit breaking-change review and migration documentation.
Serializer changes must not silently reinterpret existing business semantics.

Canonical serializers migrate legacy embedded transport lanes deterministically and reject conflicts without arbitrary resolution. Use canonical serializers for legacy XML; raw XmlSerializer is not a migration entry point.
